description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different configurations in detecting misinformation, with the x-axis representing various configurations and the y-axis showing accuracy percentages. The configurations are labeled as "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." The accuracy percentages range from approximately 80.1% to 90.57%. The "Ours" configuration has the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by "w/o emotion" at 87.34%, and "w/o select" at 87.17%. The lowest accuracy is observed in the "w/o cognition" configuration at 80.1%. The bars are color-coded, with "Ours" in red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o select" in light blue, "w/o emotion" in dark blue, and "w/o cognition" in yellow. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
